exposure: ultrasound-guided bladder localization (USBL) combined with preoperative assessment of uterine sliding distance
cohort: 174 pregnant women undergoing repeat cesarean sections at Shijiazhuang Fourth Hospital were enrolled in the study.
finding: Ultrasound-guided bladder localization (USBL) significantly reduced intraoperative blood loss, operative time, and bladder/intestinal injuries, while also improving scar healing, quality of life, and reducing stress urinary incontinence in women undergoing repeat cesarean sections.
